WITH yearly_consumption AS (
    
    SELECT
        c."segment",
        SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4)::INTEGER AS year,
        SUM(ym."consumption") AS total_consumption
    FROM
        "yearmonth" ym
    JOIN
        "customers" c ON ym."customerid" = c."customerid"
    WHERE
        c."currency" = 'EUR'
        AND SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY
        c."segment", SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4)::INTEGER
),

segment_changes AS (
    
    SELECT
        "segment",
        MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2013 THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013,
        MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2012 THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2013 THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) -
            MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2012 THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS absolute_change
    FROM
        yearly_consumption
    GROUP BY
        "segment"
),

percentage_changes AS (
    
    SELECT
        "segment",
        absolute_change,
        consumption_2013,
        CASE
            WHEN consumption_2013 = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (absolute_change / consumption_2013) * 100
        END AS percentage_change
    FROM
        segment_changes
)


SELECT
    'max' AS change_type,
    "segment" AS segment_with_max_change,
    percentage_change AS max_percentage_change
FROM
    percentage_changes
ORDER BY
    percentage_change DESC
LIMIT 1

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'min' AS change_type,
    "segment" AS segment_with_min_change,
    percentage_change AS min_percentage_change
FROM
    percentage_changes
ORDER BY
    percentage_change ASC
LIMIT 1;
